scope: Shared OFD O_NONBLOCK/O_APPEND status and worker F_SETFL/FIONBIO; descriptor membership and CLOEXEC remain frozen.

reused_serial_guest.reason: Final code change is only PendingIo worker EAGAIN retry; serial owner unchanged.

paired_benchmark.method: Same ARM64 ELF, 256 rounds, five FD controls plus one empty pipe read per round; runnable guest thread ensures a real cohort. Five paired samples per 2/4 CPUs, order alternates. No concurrent build during recorded paired timing. This is a coordination-heavy mechanism workload, not CoreMark/Docker or product throughput.
paired_benchmark.reuse_reason: The final fix only rereads status for a previously parked byte call returning EAGAIN. This benchmark always sets nonblocking before starting empty reads, and never creates such a pending read.

metrics.worker_fd_syscalls: Completed worker F_GETFD/F_GETFL/F_SETFL/FIONBIO, including errno. Excludes descriptor creation/dup/close/CLOEXEC.

limitations: FD table/OFD body and namespace lifecycle still have owner/cohort dependencies.
One Arc allocation per original OFD for mutable status; no byte endpoint/socket lifetime extension.
No Apple/iPad execution or IPA; no end-to-end CoreMark/Docker speed claim.
Unchanged CPU/MMU/GPU/Firefox and full compatibility probes reused; not rerun.
